# APEX
> The motorcycle coach that works after the ride. A kit that lives on the bike reads line, braking and throttle and delivers a corner-by-corner review on the rider's phone, with one thing to work on next time. Kit, fitting and 12 months of reviews in one price, from €49.90. APEX Srl, Milan.

## Packs
- APEX Start €49.90 — under 25 or licensed < 12 months
- APEX Rider €89.90 — everyone
- APEX Pro €179.90 — track, lap-by-lap analysis (pre-order soon)
All include kit, fitting and 12 months of reviews. No subscription, no payment on the site.
